notice: 51 capability families are a preliminary coverage audit, NOT exhaustive command/option tests and NOT certified parity.
evidence_scope: Committed redacted machine-readable artifacts with SHA-256 checksums; private original DWG files MUST NOT be placed in this public repository.
independent_approval_policy: An approval requires complete per-family scenario coverage, real AutoCAD 2026 and MusaCAD same-input comparison, independent DWG read/reopen, three platform runs, successful CI and an independently reviewed evidence package. Any missing/failed gate is not an approval.
